title: Q-SEED-unlearn: seed unlearn is built, not yet built, deployed and running a year unattended
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation seedship --probe unlearn
**Status:** open

SEED-SHIP-1: a seed on the platform is built, deployed and made fully autonomous, designed to run unattended for at least one year. Seed `unlearn` is at stage `built`. Still missing: a live-verified deploy of ultrastable-unlearn at an https URL. Build and deploy it on a branch through the normal lane; do not close this by editing the stage, a check or the baseline.
